description: This file is a web scraper for Yummly recipes, utilizing Puppeteer for headless browsing and Cheerio for HTML parsing. It fetches recipe details such as image, name, tags, ingredients, instructions, total time, and servings.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details, imported from a helper module.

methods.name: customPuppeteerFetch
methods.description: Fetches HTML content from a URL using Puppeteer, with resource blocking and dynamic 'load more' handling.

methods.name: yummy
methods.description: Main function that takes a recipe URL, fetches the page, and extracts recipe data into a schema object.
